newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy's Ciampi optimistic key 1997 budget on track.
newsitem.headline: Italy's Ciampi optimistic key 1997 budget on track.

text.p: The Italian government is putting the final touches to its key 1997 budget aiming to achieve 32.4 trillion lire in deficit cuts and is optimistic the measures are on course, Treasury Minister Carlo Azeglio Ciampi said on Thursday.
"We're working on it, we're optimistic and have confidence in what's being done," Ciampi told reporters as he left the lower house of parliament.
He confirmed the cabinet would meet on the budget on September 27, the date the government is expected to have the budget package ready for presentation to parliament.
The budget package must be presented to parliament by September 30. Both chambers then have until December 31 to approve it.
